component.name: GeminiDesk
component.summary: Unofficial lightweight Rust desktop client for Google Gemini

description.p: Features include a single shared WebView across Main Window, Quick Chat, and Floating Companion, Wayland XDG Desktop Portal integration (GlobalShortcuts, Screenshot, Settings color scheme), StatusNotifierItem system tray for KDE Plasma, and opt-in productivity workflows.
First cross-platform beta with Linux Wayland/KDE Plasma portal integration, macOS bundle infrastructure, native Windows installer, and Ed25519-verified automatic updates.
